jobs.title: VP, Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
Current Employees of Happen Bank: Please apply via your internal Workday Account

Happen Bank (formerly LendingClub) is built around a simple purpose: to clear the way to help people turn intention into action, and action into financial progress. That means offering focused products, a frictionless mobile-first experience, and clear terms with no gotchas. Respect and fairness is part of our DNA, and that ideal shapes how we work, how we treat each other, and how we invest in our employees and our community. Join us in using data, bold thinking, and a commitment to innovation to help clear the way for millions of Americans to achieve more.

About The Role

The VP, Platform Engineering is the senior-most leader of Platform Engineering at Happen Bank, responsible for the strategy, roadmap, and execution of the foundational platforms that enable product engineering teams across the company. This leader owns AI Infrastructure, DevOps and software delivery, Change Management, enterprise Testing, Database Administration, and Incident Management & Observability.

You’ll bring deep technical expertise and executive leadership to build the platforms, guardrails, and services that enable Engineering teams to move quickly, safely, and reliably. A key focus will be defining Happen Bank’s multi-year AI Infrastructure strategy—including model and platform selection, build-versus-buy decisions, client-facing AI capabilities, governance, and shared tooling—while advancing software delivery, quality, database reliability, and production resilience across the technology organization.

You’ll partner across Technology and Product Engineering to align platform investments with the broader technology, product, and AI modernization agenda, building a high-performing organization grounded in the belief that speed, quality, and safety are all requirements.

What You'll Do

AI Infrastructure Vision & Strategy

Own the enterprise vision, strategy, and roadmap for AI Infrastructure, including evaluation and selection of AI/LLM models and platforms and a clear point of view on which capabilities to build in-house versus consume as a service
Lead the development of client-facing AI technologies, gateways, and shared tooling that enable product teams to safely and efficiently integrate AI capabilities into customer experiences
Establish standards for model governance, cost management, latency, security, safety, and scalability as AI adoption grows across the engineering organization

Developer Platform, DevOps & Software Delivery

Define the strategy and standards for CI/CD, developer tooling, infrastructure as code, automated deployment, and environment management to measurably improve engineering velocity and reliability
Own the roadmap for build and release capabilities, ensuring tooling and processes scale with engineering headcount, product surface area, and technical complexity
Establish and continuously evolve Change Management guardrails, release controls, testing expectations, sign-offs, rollback plans, and monitoring standards that enable teams to ship quickly while protecting customer experience and production stability
Use incident and defect data to continuously improve software delivery and Change Management practices, balancing delivery speed, quality, and risk

Enterprise Testing & Quality

Own the enterprise testing strategy and shared testing capabilities across Software Engineering, Data, and other technology teams
Define quality standards, testing expectations, and SLAs that establish clear release-readiness requirements across Product and Platform Engineering
Advance AI-enabled testing practices, including automation, self-healing tests, and AI-assisted test generation, to improve coverage and efficiency while reducing manual QA effort

Database Administration

Lead the Database Administration function, establishing a clear charter, priorities, and service expectations for Engineering and the broader organization
Ensure the DBA organization delivers high-leverage capabilities across performance tuning, schema design guidance, capacity planning, and data reliability
Partner with Engineering leaders to proactively identify and address database risks, scalability needs, and opportunities as the platform evolves

Incident Management & Observability

Own a robust incident management framework from detection and response through resolution and post-incident review, with a focus on minimizing customer impact and strengthening root-cause learning
Establish clear SLAs, SLOs, and operational expectations that provide real-time visibility into system health and enable teams to proactively identify and recover from degraded services
Strengthen the enterprise observability strategy and stack in partnership with Technology Operations, driving consistent instrumentation, alerting, dashboards, and operational standards across the technology environment

Platform Strategy & Organizational Leadership

Set the strategy and multi-year roadmap across Platform Engineering, aligning investments and priorities with the broader product development and technology roadmap
Anticipate emerging platform needs and determine where Happen Bank should invest to improve engineering productivity, reliability, scalability, security, and innovation
Represent Platform Engineering in enterprise technology strategy, planning, and investment decisions, providing clear recommendations on priorities, tradeoffs, and resource allocation
Build, coach, and retain a high-performing leadership organization across AI Infrastructure, DevOps, Testing, DBA, and Observability, with a strong focus on talent development and leadership bench strength

About You

13+ years of progressive software engineering, DevOps, platform engineering, or related technology experience, including significant experience leading complex engineering organizations
Bachelor's degree or higher, or equivalent combination of education and experience
10+ years in a senior engineering leadership role leading multiple technical domains and managers of managers, with experience across AI Infrastructure, DevOps, Testing, DBA, Observability, or related platform functions
Demonstrated experience setting AI Infrastructure strategy, including evaluating and selecting AI/LLM models and platforms and building client-facing AI gateways, tooling, or capabilities in production environments
Deep technical fluency across DevOps pipelines, testing harnesses and automation, API and contract design, database architecture, and observability, with the ability to go deep with technical teams while operating at an executive and strategic level
Track record of building and maturing observability practices, SLA/SLO frameworks, and incident management processes at scale, with a high bar for operational excellence and root-cause analysis
Experience leading or partnering closely with Database Administration functions, with a clear perspective on how DBA teams can deliver high-leverage value to Engineering
Experience building enterprise testing strategies and shared testing capabilities, with a focus on automation and AI-enabled testing efficiency
Practical experience building platforms and shared services across modern distributed technology environments, including Java, Scala, and/or Node.js; databases such as Postgres, MySQL, Cassandra, or DynamoDB; and asynchronous messaging technologies such as SQS/SNS or Kafka
Strong executive presence and cross-functional influence with the ability to align platform investments with company, product, and technology strategy
Demonstrated success developing leaders and building leadership bench strength across complex, multi-domain engineering organizations
You build functions that evolve, embedding AI capabilities into how strategy is developed and executed. You create the systems and conditions for teams to challenge assumptions and deliver breakthroughs while maintaining a high standard for security, model governance, data integrity, responsible production deployment, and long-term maintainability

Nice to Have

Experience in fintech or banking, particularly within Loan Originations, Servicing, or Banking Web and Mobile Applications

Work Location

San Francisco

The above locations are eligible offices for this role. The locations have been determined to foster in-person collaboration with this role’s team or the related business lines. We utilize a hybrid work model, and our teams are in-office Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. In-person attendance is essential for this role’s success, and remote placement will not be considered. Happen Bank offers relocation, based on actual job level.

Time Zone Requirements

Local hours (PT)

While the position will primarily work local hours, Happen Bank is headquartered in Pacific Time and our ideal candidate will be flexible working across time zones when necessary.

Travel Requirements

As needed travel to Happen Bank offices and/or other locations, as needed.

Compensation

The target base salary range for this position is 260,000-290,000. The base salary of the role will be determined by job-related knowledge, experience, education, skills, and location. Base salary is just one part of Happen Bank's Total Rewards package. You may also be eligible for long-term awards (equity) and an annual bonus (which is based on company performance, employee performance and eligible earnings).

We’re creating new financial services solutions for our members based on fairness, simplicity, and heart, and we treat our employees the same way. We offer a competitive benefits package that includes medical, dental and vision plans for employees and their families, 401(k) match, health and wellness programs, flexible time off policies for salaried employees, up to 16 weeks paid parental leave and more.

Happen Bank is an equal opportunity employer and dedicated to diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We believe that a variety of perspectives will make our teams and business stronger as we work together to transform the traditional banking system.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at interviewaccommodations@happen.com.

Notice on AI Tool Use

For select roles and locations, candidate interviews may be recorded, transcribed and summarized by tools such as artificial intelligence (AI) to assist our hiring managers with the application process.

You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription, and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews. We will not discriminate against you if you choose to opt out.

During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information from or about you: contact information, identifiers, professional and employment-related information, sensory information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment.

We will only share your interview, transcription, or summary with persons whose expertise or technology is necessary to process your application, evaluate your fitness for a position, and administer or support the tool. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, please refer to our Privacy Disclosure.

jobs.title: Head of Technical Operations and Clinical Engineering
jobs.description:
Cardiosense is a rapidly growing, venture-backed medical AI company that is redefining how we detect, monitor, and manage heart disease. We're developing novel wearable sensors and advanced machine learning algorithms that translate raw physiological signals into clinically actionable, digital biomarkers used to detect early signs of cardiac worsening, guide personalized therapy, and improve patient outcomes.

Our team brings together experts in data science, biosignal analysis, and medicine united by a common mission to identify and combat preventable cardiac disease. Cardiosense's solutions are built on over a decade of clinical research and we continue to collaborate with the world's leading academic institutions to introduce the next generation of cardiac monitoring and disease management.

About The Role

The Head Technical Operations and Clinical Engineering role is essential in developing innovative solutions that provide clinically relevant insights from non-invasive sensors for Cardiosense. Your work will directly impact the advancement of healthcare technologies and improve patient outcomes, making a significant difference in the medical field.

Responsibilities

Deployment and Customer Integration

Own end-to-end deployment of Cardiosense deployment for new customers, from technical scoping through go-live and steady-state support

Serve as the primary point of contact to hospital IT, biomed/clinical engineering, and information security teams.
Define and maintain the on-boarding procedures including device procurement and provisioning, fleet management, workflow mapping, and staff training.
Manage integration workstreams with hospital systems and third-party cardiac data platforms, coordinating with engineering on interfacing requirements and data flow.
Build the field support model, including tiering, SLAs, and the feedback to R&D.

Commercial & Performance Monitoring

Support Commercial to define a successful deployment including activation milestones, sustained utilization thresholds, and per-site economics.

Own instrumentation and reporting of device and platform usage, building the metrics infrastructure and recurring reporting cadence used by Commercial for account decisions.
Own account monitoring across deployed sites including utilization, workflow breakdowns, or technical friction to allow for early intervention
Translate deployment and utilization data into commercial strategy inputs and use that analysis to contribute to commercial planning.
Own technical and operation content to customer-facing materials that helps solution expansion and increases site utilization

Hardware supply and manufacturing operations

Manage the contract manufacturing and external design partners: statement of works, build plan, cost, yield, and quality

Drive the accessory and device improvements roadmap through partners from requirements through design transfer and verification
Own build planning and inventory across the demo program, clinical studies, and commercial deployment.

Clinical Engineering

Support execution of clinical validation studies demonstrating performance and clinical utility of Cardiosense solutions, with commercialization endpoint defined early on.

Provide operational and technical support to clinical studies, including site activation, device logistics, and data integrity.
Provide oversight on data monitoring and execution, flagging when sites drift out of protocol early

Product and R&D Insights and Support

Provide real-world usage into prioritized requirements for the algorithm and applications team

Identify data collection opportunities that support algorithm improvements and expansion indications, in coordination with the PCCP framework
Advise on product roadmap tradeoffs where deployment feasibility, manufacturability, or clinical utilization are gating factors.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field

8+ years of experience in medical devices, digital health, clinical engineering, healthcare technology, or a related technical environment
Demonstrated experience leading technical deployments, implementations, or integrations within hospitals or health systems
Experience working directly with hospital stakeholders, including clinicians, clinical engineering/biomed, IT, information security, and/or research teams
Strong analytical skills with experience developing metrics, dashboards, reporting, or other data driven tools used to monitor performance and support business decisions
Working knowledge across hardware, software, and clinical workflows, with the ability to effectively communicate with specialized teams in each area
Experience developing and implementing new operational processes, particularly in environments where processes and infrastructure are still being built
Demonstrated ability to independently scope problems, identify solutions, make decisions, and drive workstreams through completion
Strong cross functional leadership and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical information for clinical, commercial, and operational audiences
Experience managing multiple concurrent workstreams with competing priorities in a fast paced environment

$130,000 - $170,000 a year

Cardiosense is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, disability status, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Job Summary

Responsible for the direction, coordination, planning, budgeting and oversight of all activities related to the department. Leads the implementation, operation, and maintenance of all components of the applications to support IT customers, and to achieve established objectives, promote quality, and drive business value in compliance with internal and external policies and procedures. Directs and manages the delivery of large or complex projects. Works closely with appropriate IT governing bodies and other IT leaders to ensure high quality service deliver and ongoing support. Partners with operational leaders within and beyond IT to identify, assess, and prioritize meaningful opportunities to use applications within departmental settings, and to develop the people, processes, and technologies to achieve that objective. Responsible for developing metrics and accountabilities for the department functions. Coordinates and manages the strategy for multiple locations as they share job functions. Actively leads efforts to improve systems, processes and contracts that result in top performance. Understands and aligns with the strategic vision and executional priorities. Collaborates with the leadership team. Responsible for the interviewing, hiring, discipline of employees and any other personnel issues that arise. Completes performance appraisals. Handles day-to-day operations, while focusing on the broader view including strategic growth, best in class operational practices, and advocating for new technologies. Delivers high customer satisfaction and retention of profitable business through formal reports, and data analytics. Leads resolution across all areas within the operation organization. Responsible for oversight of vendor management, contracts, and support agreements. Responsible for statement of work review related to project leadership. Determines performance objectives/metrics and defines tools to measure progress and ensure consistent achievement of business objectives. Directs, motivates, develops and manages the performance of management team and key staff. Creates opportunities for individuals to exercise and grow new skills. Demonstrates the ability to provide strong leadership that mentors, develops and guides. Committed to growth including personal and professional development and life-long learning. Attends mandatory educational requirements as directed by the organization. Must have excellent presentation and communication skills, strong interpersonal skills and analytical skills necessary to develop policies, plans and goals. Able to work with growth and development needs. Strong negotiation and marketing skills are necessary. Able to balance multiple complex projects and deadlines by determining critical issues, timelines, and priorities. Knowledge of current clinical practice, regulatory healthcare requirements, and healthcare information systems.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, management information systems (MIS), business, or a related field.

Minimum Five Years' Experience In Management Required.

Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Foundation certification preferred.

Sanford offers an attractive benefits package for qualifying full-time and part-time employees. Depending on eligibility, a variety of benefits include health insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, life insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan, work/life balance benefits, and a generous time off package to maintain a healthy home-work balance. jobs.title: Engineering Director, Storage
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Roblox's infrastructure supports over 100M DAUs and recently supported a world record 45M players at the same time. The scale is real.

As Director of Engineering, you will own the technical strategy, design, delivery, and operation of Roblox's storage systems. The challenge is scale, efficiency, reliability, and innovation all at once. We are mostly on-prem but also in the cloud — yes, we're actually building a lot of this ourselves, and yes, we know how hard that is. We've got the scale and the talent to do it.

You've spent your career deep in storage: databases, caches, queues, object storage. You understand that reliability is the most important feature of any system. You care deeply about the success of the internal and external customers who depend on these systems. You're excited to shepherd a fast-growing platform from the nearly 1 exabyte we have today to a multi-exabyte deployment that will power some of the most interesting AI workloads in the industry.

You will

Own the technical strategy, architecture, and roadmap for Roblox's storage systems, including distributed databases, caches, queues, object storage, and encryption infrastructure
Ensure our storage platform scales by orders of magnitude while remaining reliable and efficient
Partner closely with Data Platform, Infrastructure, and product engineering teams to align storage capabilities with Roblox's technical and business needs
Build, grow, and retain a world-class storage engineering team — and develop the next generation of technical leaders within it
Drive operational excellence: define and hold the bar on reliability, on-call practices, and incident response
Own your systems end-to-end, including participation in on-call rotation for critical incidents

You have

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field
10+ years of experience in storage, infrastructure, or distributed systems roles, including hands-on experience building and operating custom database systems - not just deploying off-the-shelf solutions - plus depth in at least several of: caching systems, object storage, message queues, or data streaming
5+ years in engineering leadership, managing teams through ambiguity to deliver critical, production-scale systems
A track record of building reliable, high-availability systems at significant scale (millions of users, petabyte-scale data, or equivalent)
Strong operational instincts — you raise the bar on reliability and execution, not just vision
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners and earn trust across engineering, product, and leadership
Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward learning: you go deep on tech stacks that are new to you and bring others along

jobs.title: Director, Network Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Description

Provide leadership for one or more Network Engineering teams or a small group delivering hyperscale L3/L4 networking and cloud connectivity. Define tactical and strategic plans, drive significant cross-group improvements in reliability, security, and cost efficiency, and communicate progress and risks to leadership. Manage elements of the budget and are accountable for meeting budget targets across the teams you lead. May have a mixed team of Network Engineers and Network Hardware Engineers, coordinating the physical network platform lifecycle (planning, sourcing, qualifying, sustaining routers/switches, optics/OLS, timing, cabling) to ensure interoperable, cost- and power-efficient components that enable reliable, secure, and compliant services at scale

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

L3/L4 Network Topologies and Overlays:

Defines multi-quarter architecture roadmap for DC fabrics, routing policy, IPv6 strategy, failure domains, and traffic engineering across regions.
Leads cross-team design reviews and modernization programs (e.g., EVPN/VXLAN/SDN upgrades); enforces MOP/rollback and verification standards.

Cloud Networking Implementation and Operations:

Standardizes VPC/VCN topologies, transit/peering, PrivateLink/service endpoints, NAT, and inter-/multi-cloud connectivity.
Optimizes L4/L7 load balancing and service-insertion at scale; enforces cost/SLO guardrails and capacity alignment.

Network Security Controls and Compliance Guardrails:

Embeds zero-trust-aligned segmentation and policy frameworks; drives rulebase lifecycle and tech-debt reduction.
Leads audit readiness and risk reduction programs with Security/GRC; implements policy-as-code and preventative controls.

Automation, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code:

Institutionalizes IaC modules/collections and GitOps; mandates code reviews, policy-as-code, testing, and safe deployment patterns (canary/auto-rollback).
Sponsors platform/tooling investments; tracks and improves DORA metrics across teams.

Monitoring, Telemetry, and SLOs:

Sets SLI/SLO policy for the group; ensures telemetry pipelines (SNMP/streaming, NetFlow/IPFIX, flow logs) support reliability, capacity, and security analytics.
Chairs capacity/performance reviews; directs right-sizing, routing optimization, and placement decisions.

Cross-Team Collaboration and Operations Excellence:

Leads cross-group incident response and complex changes; coordinates executive updates on high-importance matters.
Influences adoption of standards across adjacent orgs; negotiates with vendors and partners within budget authority.

Documentation, Reviews, and Standards:

Publishes group-level standards, reference architectures, and runbooks; ensures traceability to requirements and controls.
Operates design/change councils across teams; drives consistent documentation quality and version control.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

Oversees and guides multiple teams on managing complex projects or initiatives, monitoring timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable to ensure strategic objectives are met. Serves as a role model for appropriately delegating work, setting priorities, and ensuring alignment with business needs. Coaches others on adjusting resources or project timelines in anticipation of business changes.

Collaboration & Partnership:

Role models leading cross-functional collaborative efforts to ensure alignment of expectations and strategic objectives. Empowers team to build and maintain partnerships with business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to address barriers and contribute to organizational success. Drives transparency and inclusivity by modeling actively seeking, listening to, and leveraging diverse perspectives.

Problem Solving:

Shares problem-solving strategies across teams, providing oversight on complex operational and/or technical issues, as needed. Coaches teams on analyzing highly complex data and/or information to identify solutions to ambiguous issues, and provides direction on identifying root causes to prevent recurrence of issues.

Continuous Learning:

Pursues strategic learning opportunities to maintain expertise and apply best practices at the organizational level. Creates opportunities for team members and leaders to build their expertise in new areas, coaching them to build innovative skills. Identifies skill gap trends across the organization, and upholds a culture that places significant emphasis on sharing knowledge and pursuing learning opportunities that advance the organization. Evaluates efficiency of learning strategies and recommends adjustments as needed.

Continuous Improvement:

Empowers team to own the development and implementation of ideas that increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across the department. Coaches teams to gain buy-in for ideas and to seek feedback on approaches and methods for continued improvement. Prioritizes and reviews the roadmap of improvement initiatives to ensure alignment with strategic direction and maximize return on investments.

Performance and Development:

Serves as a role model for driving performance across teams through tailored feedback and coaching in alignment with performance management processes, guidelines, and expectations. Drives consistency in the application of talent development procedures and socializes performance expectations across the organization. Ensures that individual development goals are aligned with organizational strategic initiatives. Collaborates with HR to implement talent strategy through hiring and promotion processes.

jobs.title: Head of Information Technology & Business Systems
jobs.description:
Build the Technology Foundation for the Next Generation of Our Marketplace

Autoland is a well-established, nationally recognized marketplace that connects consumers, financial institutions, and vehicles. Our history is established, but our mindset is entrepreneurial: we operate with the agility and ambition of a startup, backed by the stability and resources of a mature organization.

We are seeking a Head of Information Technology & Business Systems to lead the company's transition from internally developed applications to a modern, platform-based ecosystem. Reporting directly to the President & CEO, this leader will architect the systems, integrations, and data foundations that power the future of our digital marketplace, and will stay hands-on in execution.

Why This Role Is Different

This is not a traditional infrastructure leadership position. Our day-to-day IT operations and end-user support are delivered through managed service partners, keeping this role focused on business systems, integration, data architecture, and the platform transition. You will build the foundation for our next generation marketplace platform while leading a talented engineering team through a major evolution in how technology is delivered.

What You'll Do

Systems & Architecture

Own the company's business systems ecosystem, including Salesforce and future platform investments.
Define the data architecture, system-of-record ownership, and integration standards that let independent platforms share data reliably.
Lead Salesforce implementation, administration, integrations, and data strategy, managing implementation partners and ensuring delivery quality, security, adoption, and ROI.

Platform Migration

Lead the migration from proprietary software to modern SaaS and platform-based systems, sequencing cutovers with minimal business disruption.
Ensure historical data remains available for reporting, compliance, and analytics.

Vendor & Technology Management

Evaluate and select platforms and vendors; negotiate and manage contracts and renewals; oversee the managed service providers responsible for IT operations and support.
Manage the function's operating budget, including platform subscriptions, vendor contracts, and managed services spend.
Own identity and access management, and partner with cybersecurity, compliance, and infrastructure stakeholders on business continuity, audit readiness, and privacy.

Engineering Leadership

Coach and develop a team transitioning from software development to platform engineering and systems integration.
Evaluate automation, AI, and emerging technologies, implementing practical solutions with measurable business value.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
8+ years of progressive experience in: Information Technology, Business Systems, Systems Integration, Software Engineering, or Data Architecture.
3+ years of experience leading and developing high-performing technical teams.
Experience leading enterprise CRM, ERP, or business systems implementations.
Hands-on Salesforce experience including architecture, administration, integrations, or data migration.
A track record of modernizing or replacing a proprietary or legacy platform, migrating its functions onto commercial platforms, including sequencing cutovers and managing the engineering work.
Digital marketplace, fintech, e-commerce, or B2B2C experience.
Strong expertise in: APIs, integration platforms, data governance, cloud technologies, and cybersecurity best practices.
Experience managing technology vendors and implementation partners.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical realities into plain language for the business.
Comfortable operating hands-on in a small company where the leader is also a practitioner, and where adaptability and cross-functional collaboration are essential.

Why Join Autoland?

Direct partnership with the CEO and a seat at the leadership table.
Real ownership of the systems the business runs on, and the opportunity to build the data foundation for the next generation of the business.
High-impact role with long-term growth opportunity.

If you are a hands-on technology executive who enjoys building scalable systems, leading transformational change, and creating business value through modern platforms and integrations, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and help build the future of automotive retail and financing technology.

Autoland LLC

Woodland Hills, CA | Hybrid | Full-Time

$190,000 - $205,000 per year

jobs.title: Vice President - Internal Technology Strategy and Engagement
jobs.description:
In the Technology division, we leverage innovation to build the connections and capabilities that power our Firm, enabling our clients and colleagues to redefine markets and shape the future of our communities.

This is a Technology Leadership & Strategy position at the Vice President level, which is part of the job family responsible for driving innovation, developing technology roadmaps, and providing vision and strategic direction to align technology initiatives with long-term business objectives, fostering a culture of excellence, growth and transformation across the organization.

Morgan Stanley is an industry leader in financial services, known for mobilizing capital to help governments, corporations, institutions, and individuals around the world achieve their financial goals.

Interested in joining a team that’s eager to create, innovate and make an impact on the world? Read on.

As a market leader, the talent and passion of our people is critical to our success. Together, we share a common set of values rooted in integrity, excellence, and strong team ethic. Morgan Stanley can provide a superior foundation for building a professional career - a place for people to learn, to achieve and grow. A philosophy that balances personal lifestyles, perspectives and needs is an important part of our culture.

Team Profile

Institutional Securities Technology (IST) develops and oversees the overall technology architecture strategy and bespoke technology solutions to drive and enable the institutional businesses and enterprise-wide functions.

Our clients include Fixed Income, Equities, Commodities, Investment Banking, Research and Global Capital Markets.

Institutional Securities Group (ISG) Architecture Governance is responsible for development, communication and implementation of the Technology Architecture principles, standards, design patterns and governance that inform the development and engineering of the ISG Technology platform in support of the ISG business and horizontal Firm functions including Finance and Operations.

What You’ll Do In The Role

We are seeking an Architecture Strategy & Engagement Leader to serve as a strategic advisor and force multiplier for Architecture Governance leadership.
This role will lead the development and execution of architecture engagement, communications, and enablement strategies that improve awareness, alignment, adoption, and execution of divisional architecture priorities.
Partnering closely with senior technology executives, architects, governance leaders, and key stakeholders across the division, this individual will transform complex architectural and technology strategies into compelling executive narratives, impactful communications, and scalable engagement programs.
The ideal candidate combines the structured problem-solving of a management consultant, the strategic influence, and exceptional executive storytelling and communications capabilities.
Architecture Strategy & Advisory
Serve as a trusted advisor to senior architecture and technology leader

What You’ll Bring To The Role

10+ years experience in one or more of: internal consulting, advisory/management consulting, technology strategy, enterprise architecture enablement, program communications, or executive communications. Proven ability to create executive-level decks that drive decisions (not just inform).
Strong storytelling skills: can turn ambiguity into clarity; can simplify complex technical topics without dumbing them down.
Demonstrated experience producing diagrams and visual frameworks (architecture views, operating models, roadmaps, capability maps).
Experience running communications channels (newsletters, trainings, engagement sessions) with measurable results.
Exceptional stakeholder management skills; comfortable working with senior leaders and technical experts.
Strong writing, editing, and message discipline (tone, structure, brevity, clarity).
High proficiency with slide tools (PowerPoint preferred) and visual communication standards.
At least 8 years' relevant experience would generally be expected to find the skills required for this role,

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with enterprise architecture concepts (e.g., capability mapping, target-state, reference architectures, integration patterns).
Experience in large-scale, matrixed organizations with multiple stakeholder groups.
Experience with change management, enablement, or internal marketing practices.
Proficiency with diagramming tools and design systems.
Understanding of governance processes and decision forums (steering committees, architectural review boards, etc.).

What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.

To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.

Expected base pay rates for the role will be between $155,000 and $215,000 per year at the commencement of employment. However, base pay if hired will be determined on an individualized basis and is only part of the total compensation package, which, depending on the position, may also include commission earnings, incentive compensation, discretionary bonuses, other short and long-term incentive packages, and other Morgan Stanley sponsored benefit programs.

Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.

Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.

For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people-opportunities/eeo.
